person-actor: A person who performs in movies, TV shows, theater, or other entertainment productions.
person-artist/author: A person who creates artistic or literary works, including writers, painters, sculptors, musicians as creators, and other creative professionals.
person-athlete: A person who competes in sports or athletic events, whether professional or amateur.
person-director: A person who directs movies, TV shows, theater productions, or other media content.
person-other: A person who does not fit into the other specific person subcategories, such as historical figures, activists, or ordinary individuals mentioned by name.
person-politician: A person who holds or campaigns for political office, or is primarily known for political activities.
person-scholar: A person primarily known for academic or scientific work, including professors, researchers, and intellectuals.
person-soldier: A person who serves or served in a military or armed force, including officers, generals, and enlisted personnel.
organization-company: A commercial business entity, corporation, or firm engaged in trade, manufacturing, or services for profit.
organization-education: An educational institution such as a university, college, school, or research institute.
organization-government/governmentagency: A government body, department, ministry, or agency that exercises governmental authority or provides public services.
organization-media/newspaper: A media organization, news outlet, newspaper, magazine, broadcasting network, or publishing house.
organization-other: An organization that does not fit into the other specific organization subcategories, such as NGOs, foundations, or international bodies.
organization-politicalparty: A political party or political movement organized to participate in elections or governance.
organization-religion: A religious organization, denomination, church, order, or other faith-based institutional body.
organization-showorganization: An entertainment or performing arts organization such as a band, orchestra, dance troupe, or theater company.
organization-sportsleague: A sports league, conference, or governing body that organizes and oversees athletic competitions.
organization-sportsteam: A specific sports team that competes in organized athletic events or leagues.
location-GPE: A geopolitical entity such as a country, state, province, city, or town with defined governmental boundaries.
location-bodiesofwater: A natural or artificial body of water, including oceans, seas, rivers, lakes, and reservoirs.
location-island: An island or archipelago, whether inhabited or uninhabited.
location-mountain: A mountain, mountain range, hill, volcano, or other elevated landform.
location-other: A named location that does not fit into the other specific location subcategories, such as regions, continents, or geographic areas without clear governmental boundaries.
location-park: A park, nature reserve, national park, garden, or other designated recreational or conservation area.
location-road/railway/highway/transit: A named road, railway, highway, bridge, tunnel, transit line, or other transportation route or infrastructure.
building-airport: An airport or airfield facility used for aircraft takeoff, landing, and passenger or cargo handling.
building-hospital: A hospital, medical center, clinic, or other healthcare facility.
building-hotel: A hotel, motel, resort, inn, or other lodging establishment.
building-library: A library or archival facility that houses collections of books, documents, or other media for public or institutional use.
building-other: A named building or structure that does not fit into the other specific building subcategories, such as landmarks, monuments, palaces, or office buildings.
building-restaurant: A restaurant, café, bar, pub, or other food and beverage establishment.
building-sportsfacility: A sports facility such as a stadium, arena, gymnasium, racetrack, or sports complex.
building-theater: A theater, opera house, concert hall, or other venue primarily used for performing arts or film screenings.
art-broadcastprogram: A television show, radio program, podcast, or other broadcast or streaming media series.
art-film: A motion picture or movie, including feature films, documentaries, and short films.
art-music: A musical composition, song, album, or other musical work.
art-other: An artistic work that does not fit into the other specific art subcategories, such as sculptures, photographs, or video games as artistic works.
art-painting: A painting or drawn visual artwork, typically created on canvas, paper, or other surfaces.
art-writtenart: A written literary or artistic work such as a novel, poem, play, short story, essay, comic book, or other published text.
event-attack/battle/war/militaryconflict: A military conflict, war, battle, terrorist attack, bombing, or other armed confrontation.
event-disaster: A natural or man-made disaster such as an earthquake, hurricane, flood, famine, industrial accident, or pandemic.
event-election: A political election, referendum, or vote at any level of government.
event-other: A named event that does not fit into the other specific event subcategories, such as ceremonies, festivals, summits, or cultural events.
event-protest: A protest, demonstration, uprising, revolution, strike, riot, or other act of civil unrest or political dissent.
event-sportsevent: A sporting event, tournament, competition, race, or championship such as the Olympics, World Cup, or Super Bowl.
product-airplane: A specific model or type of aircraft, including commercial airplanes, military jets, and helicopters.
product-car: A specific model or type of automobile, including cars, trucks, motorcycles, and other road vehicles.
product-food: A named food product, beverage, dish, or brand of consumable goods.
product-game: A named game, including video games, board games, card games, and other recreational games.
product-other: A named product that does not fit into the other specific product subcategories, such as electronics, consumer goods, or industrial products.
product-ship: A specific named ship, boat, submarine, or other watercraft.
product-software: A named software application, operating system, platform, programming language, or digital tool.
product-train: A specific named train service, locomotive model, or railway rolling stock.
product-weapon: A specific type or model of weapon, including firearms, missiles, bombs, and other military armaments.
other-astronomything: An astronomical object or phenomenon such as a star, planet, galaxy, constellation, comet, or nebula.
other-award: A named award, prize, honor, medal, or distinction given in recognition of achievement.
other-biologything: A biological entity or concept such as a species, gene, protein, cell type, or biological process.
other-chemicalthing: A chemical substance, compound, element, material, or mineral.
other-currency: A named currency, monetary unit, or cryptocurrency.
other-disease: A disease, medical condition, disorder, syndrome, or illness.
other-educationaldegree: An academic degree, diploma, certification, or educational qualification.
other-god: A deity, god, goddess, or divine figure from any religion or mythology.
other-language: A human language, dialect, or programming language when referred to as a linguistic system.
other-law: A named law, regulation, statute, treaty, legal act, or constitutional provision.
other-livingthing: A living organism referred to by common name rather than scientific classification, such as a specific animal, plant, or other life form not covered by biologything.
other-medical: A medical term, treatment, procedure, drug, therapy, or medical device that is not a disease.
